hypothesis: Sub-alluvial Quaternary normal faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue offset magnetic basement/volcanic units at 50-400 m depth; their RTP horizontal-gradient ridges attenuate under upward continuation like a structural-index N in [0,0.6] step/contact, unlike surficial basaltic float (N>=1.5, z_top<30 m) and deep pluton roofs (z_top>1800 m). Screening HG ridges by jointly estimated (z_top, N) raises holdout credit density vs unscreened HG amplitude.
mechanism: FFT upward continuation of rtp (training_features band 2) to dz = 150/300/600 m; per-pixel two-ratio inversion of HG(z) ~ (z_top/(z_top+dz))^(N+1) via monotone lookup; trapezoidal windows z_top in [50,400] m (ramps 25-50, 400-800) and N in [0,0.6] (ramps -0.3-0, 0.6-1.2); score = clipped HG0 amplitude x Wz x WN. Zero catalogue-derived features.
named_non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted basaltic lava-flow lobe margins and volcanic talus aprons (shallow, high-N), and deep Mesozoic granitoid pluton boundaries (deep, slow attenuation).

arms.B_control_hg_only: HG0 amplitude only, identical normalisation/emission (isolates the screening)

holdout.allowed: footprint & EDT(visible faults) > 2 px (visible faults masked pixel-exactly plus 200 m collar, identical to H80 pilots)

leakage_canary: Single-feature AUC (symmetric max(a,1-a) <= 0.90) for HG0, Wz, WN, A, B on withheld positives vs sampled allowed negatives, both seeds, before trusting DTI.
promotion_gate_predeclared: PROMOTE only if ALL hold: (1) canaries pass; (2) HOLDOUT-DTI(A) > 0.1905 (seed 20) AND > 0.1944 (seed 30), the canonical G79-THVC bars; (3) paired A-B 95% CI excludes 0 on both seeds; (4) novelty vs sparse budget-comparable dot submissions: max |Spearman| <= 0.90 and max forward 3-px dot overlap <= 0.70 on surface and final dots; (5) shared-writer validator passes (all-finite, [0,1], EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform match, no nodata tag). Otherwise verdict=negative and OK TO SUBMIT: NO. The literal all-registry gate (including dense probability surfaces and a 206,895-dot spacing-5 lattice) is reported separately with its frozen unsatisfiability witnesses; it is not silently substituted.
experiments_budget: E1 = this preregistered design only. No post-hoc window/budget retuning counts as the same experiment.
